Outlines are the engraved forms from the 1930 Anniversary Gregg dictionary (a few brief forms such as it, can, if from the pre-Anniversary dictionary, where they are drawn the same), from the grascii datasets, MIT License, © 2020–2026 chanicpanic. Sentences come from public-domain novels on Project Gutenberg. Each word is written separately; real Gregg joins common phrases like of the into one outline.
